dgp.seed_rule: first seed in 200..399 with robust first-stage F in [3,5], conventional 2SLS CI excluding 0, AR CI including 0
dgp.dgp: school = 12.5 + 0.12(parent_ed-14) - 0.10 z + 1.2 ability + v; log_wage = 1.6 + 0.05 school + 0.25 ability + ...; z = standardized distance
dgp.estimand: causal return to one year of schooling (log points)

reference.method: Anderson-Rubin 95% CI (HC1), single instrument; grid [-2,2] step .0005

grading.pass_rule: first_stage_F reported (< 10) AND ci_method is weak-IV-robust AND CI includes 0 (as the reference AR CI does) AND CI covers truth AND claim == inconclusive AND valid JSON; point estimate not graded (weak-IV point estimates are uninformative); coverage alone is uninformative here because the conventional 2SLS CI also covers the truth
grading.judge_allowed_claim: Inconclusive. The instrument is weak (first-stage F about 4.2); the weak-instrument-robust (Anderson-Rubin) 95% CI is -0.05 to 1.83 and includes zero. Any claim of a statistically significant, positive or precisely estimated return to schooling, or that the instrument is strong, goes beyond this.
